'''Sense Force''', also known as '''See Force''' or in traditional [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]] as '''''tactus otium''''', was a [[Sense]]-based [[Force power/Legends|Force power]]. It allowed an individual to sense the ambient [[The Force/Legends|Force]] in a given area. It allowed an individual to sense the magnitude of Force in an area, person, or object, and even if that Force was aligned with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], or the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]].

==Practice==
To practice and hone this ability, [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had to relax their perceptions so that everything surrounding them becomes a blur. With a lot of patience and practice, the Force would reveal itself and let the practitioner see an area's Force signature and revealing whether it is sickly, beneficial or malevolent.<ref name="Jedi Path" />

In some places where the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] is quite strong, this sense provides the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] with a bit of a warning before approaching the site.<ref name="Jedi Path" /> Sometimes, beings could sense the alignment of other Force users, like Yoda did to Dooku.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>  Those skilled in the Force could also try to counteract this power by [[Force stealth|hiding themselves]],<ref name="Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]''</ref> or being near a nexus of the side they were opposed to.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

==Examples==
During his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] on the swamp-planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used this [[Force power/Legends|Sense]]-based [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] when approaching the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. He later commented on it in the [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]].<ref name="Jedi Path" />

Being guided by the voice of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] spirit, [[Yoda/Legends|Master Yoda]] also came across the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]] where he had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the future [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and an illusion of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] telling him to join him.<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>

Qui-Gon Jinn has been practicing this ability on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and appeared amazed by the amount of life at the planet.<ref name="Jedi Path" />
